summary.text: Pavel Payano is a Democratic state senator from Massachusetts who has represented the 1st Essex District since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A former school committee member in Lawrence, he worked in nonprofit and Democratic Party roles before entering the Senate.

paragraphs.text: Payano earned a bachelor's degree in political science from the University of Massachusetts Amherst in 2006, a master's degree in public affairs from the University of Massachusetts Boston in 2011, and a law degree from Suffolk University in 2015.

His career experience includes working as director of community mobilization at The Social Innovation Forum, as an SEIS teacher with the Collaborative for Educational Services, as outreach director of the Massachusetts Democratic Party, and as a special assistant and immigration specialist for former U.S. Representative Niki Tsongas.
He also served as New Hampshire Latino campaign co-director and a field director for Barack Obama's 2008 presidential campaign.
Payano served on the Lawrence Public Schools school board, District C, from 2011 to 2017.
He assumed office in the Senate on January 4, 2023.

For the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Joint Committee on Consumer Protection and Professional Licensure, is vice chair of the Joint Committee on Advanced Information Technology, the Internet, and Cybersecurity, and sits on the Senate Ways and Means Committee.
